# Context-exclusion patterns for tools that explicitly support .githubignore.
# This file is not a Git feature and is not a security boundary. Verify support
# in each consuming GitHub integration before relying on it.

# Credentials and local configuration
.env
.env.*
secrets/
*.pem
*.key
*.p12
*.pfx

# Version-control internals and local editors
.git/
.idea/
.vscode/

# Dependencies, build output, caches, and test artifacts
node_modules/
vendor/
target/
build/
dist/
out/
coverage/
.cache/
.pytest_cache/
.mypy_cache/
.ruff_cache/

# Large or generated binary artifacts
*.zip
*.tar
*.gz
*.png
*.jpg
*.jpeg
*.gif
*.webp
*.pdf

# Never use ignore rules as a substitute for removing committed secrets or
# enforcing access control. Sensitive material does not belong in the repository.
